Class LeaderboardOverlay

java.lang.Object
view.widgets.LeaderboardOverlay
public final class LeaderboardOverlay extends Object
Full-screen overlay showing the global DB leaderboard. Click ✕ or the dark backdrop to dismiss.

    • show

      public static void show(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane root, List<ScoreRecord> leaderboard, int rankPosition, int myPoints, String myName)
      Displays the leaderboard overlay on top of the given root pane.
      Parameters:
      root - the root stack pane to attach the overlay to
      leaderboard - the list of score records to display
      rankPosition - the rank of the current player
      myPoints - the score of the current player
      myName - the nickname of the current player
